blurb: Guests experience hot air balloon flights over Coachella Valley, including views of Palm Springs, San Diego, and Los Angeles. Flights are mostly scheduled in the morning and early afternoon. The company accommodates individuals, couples, and small groups, with accessible baskets featuring doors for easy entry and exit.
extraNote: Cancellations or rescheduling must be made 48 hours prior to flight to avoid charge · Weather-related cancellations are not billed and can be rescheduled subject to availability · No-shows billed in full and gift certificates considered used · Online reservations must be made seven days prior to flight date · Groups must book under same credit card to receive discounted group rate
